upstream.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.

classification.analysis: Agency Agents is a large library of markdown-defined AI agent personas (engineering, design, academic, finance, game-dev, and more) meant to be installed into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and other coding assistants. Each agent file encodes an identity, workflows, and deliverables so a generic coding assistant can be switched into a specialized persona on demand. Install scripts and a companion native app handle cross-tool installation and updates. Aimed at solo developers who want ready-made specialist subagents without writing their own system prompts.

use_cases.title: Install specialized coding subagents into Claude Code
Add domain-expert agent personas to Cursor or Codex
Browse agent definitions for prompt-engineering ideas
Install only specific agent divisions like engineering or security
